project_type: React Native + Expo mobile app (JavaScript) + Node.js/Express backend, greenfield
build_system: npm for backend; Expo CLI (npx expo) for mobile. No monorepo tooling — two separate package.json roots: prowash-backend/ and prowash-mobile/.
test_framework: None configured. Verification is done by running the app and backend and checking console output / emulator behavior.
build_command: Backend: cd prowash-backend && npm install && node server.js  |  Mobile: cd prowash-mobile && npx expo start --android
test_command: Backend: node -e "require('./app')" from prowash-backend/ to verify no syntax/import errors.  Mobile: npx expo export --platform android to verify bundler can resolve all imports.
verification_instructions: 1. Start MongoDB (already running on 127.0.0.1:27017 — confirmed). 2. cd prowash-backend && npm run dev — should log 'PROWASH backend running on port 5000'. 3. In second terminal: cd prowash-mobile && npx expo start --android — Metro bundler starts, app opens on Android emulator. 4. Full smoke test: create inspection → add before photos → view history → start return → add after photos → compare → view damage report.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prowash-backend/uploads/ — created at runtime by multer when first file is uploaded. Not committed to git.
environment_constraints: OS: Windows 11, PowerShell. Node v24.12.0, npm 11.6.2, npx expo 6.3.12. MongoDB running locally on 127.0.0.1:27017. Android emulator loopback address is 10.0.2.2. Do NOT use 'localhost' as the API base URL in the mobile app — use 10.0.2.2:5000. Backend must listen on 0.0.0.0 (Express default) so emulator can connect. Do not restart MongoDB.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exist (greenfield). Follow the plan in prowash-plan.md exactly.
key_patterns: Backend: Express routes in routes/inspections.js, Mongoose models in models/, services in services/. All endpoints prefixed /api. Media served via GET /api/uploads/* (not static middleware). Mobile: screens in src/screens/, API calls centralized in src/services/api.js, colors in src/constants/colors.js, navigation in src/navigation/AppNavigator.js. No Redux — local useState + Context only.
